channel.title: Tickets & Tails
channel.description: A travel journal for dogs and cats.

item.title: Meet Future, Lili and Lilou
item.description: Lili and Lilou, cats born in July 2016 who came from a pet shop in the Paris region to Korea, and Future, a Shih Tzu adopted in Daegu in 2024. The family is planning a move from Korea to Texas.

item.title: Six-Foot Leash, Closed Trails
item.description: Official U.S. National Park Service and Texas State Parks rules for camping with a dog, including the six-foot leash and trails that stay closed to pets.

item.title: Korea-to-U.S. Pet Move Checklist
item.description: A printable checklist for moving a dog and cats from South Korea to the United States, drawn from CDC, USDA APHIS and Korea’s APQA official pages.

item.title: Flying Dogs and Cats on the Same Itinerary
item.description: Official differences that matter when a dog and cats fly on the same itinerary, from CDC import rules, USDA APHIS, the FAA and the U.S. Department of Transportation.
